attempt.context: Phase 50 end-to-end verification using Playwright against production server build.
attempt.error: `pnpm --dir docs-site run build` had been blocked by engine package root exports pulling a client component into a server route dependency chain.
attempt.analysis: The failure came from `@dungeonbreak/engine` exporting `DungeonBreakGame` from its root entry, which caused Next 16 server compilation to traverse React hooks when `app/api/mcp/route.ts` imported runtime symbols.
attempt.fix: Phase 52-05 introduced `@dungeonbreak/engine/runtime`, updated server/shared docs-site imports to use it, and restored successful production-style builds.

attempt.context: Vercel install phase for docs-site repeatedly re-entered workspace install during lifecycle execution.
attempt.error: `docs-site` `postinstall` ran `ensure-kaplay-game`, which called `pnpm install` inside another workspace package and recursively triggered the same lifecycle scripts.
attempt.analysis: The loop was caused by a nested package-manager invocation inside a lifecycle hook, not by Next itself. Because `packages/kaplay-demo` is in the same workspace, `pnpm --dir ... install` scoped all workspace projects again.
attempt.fix: Removed the nested install from `docs-site/scripts/ensure-kaplay-game.mjs` and stopped invoking that script from `docs-site` `postinstall`.

attempt.context: Docs-site production build after the install-loop fix advanced to compilation and failed on a server/client boundary violation.
attempt.error: Next 16 rejected server imports that traversed `@dungeonbreak/engine` root exports because the root entry also re-exported `DungeonBreakGame` with React hooks.
attempt.analysis: Runtime consumers in API routes and shared server modules only needed engine logic/types, but the package entrypoint mixed those with a client component export. That contaminated server dependency graphs.
attempt.fix: Added `packages/engine/src/runtime.ts`, published it as `@dungeonbreak/engine/runtime`, and moved server/shared docs-site imports to that entrypoint before rebuilding the engine package.

attempt.context: Phase 58 targeted formatting verification after the new level-content and Unreal browser changes.
attempt.error: `pnpm dlx ultracite fix ...` failed because Ultracite has no usable linter configuration at this repo root.
attempt.analysis: The execution work itself was valid; the failure was tooling configuration, not code quality. Targeted TypeScript checks and unit tests were used instead.
attempt.fix: Recorded the tooling gap and verified the touched TypeScript surfaces with `pnpm --dir docs-site exec tsc --noEmit --pretty false`, `pnpm --dir packages/engine exec tsc --noEmit --pretty false`, and focused Vitest suites.
